articles.summary: HOUSTON --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Jun. 15, 2026-- Forum Energy Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: FET) announced today that Neal Lux, President and Chief Executive Officer, is scheduled to present at the Planet MicroCap Las Vegas 2026 Conference on Wednesday, June 17, 2026 at 2:00 p.m.
